content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Notification No. C-78/2026-IIMK.HR dated 23.09.2026 (Corrigendum No.29-02(127)/2026.IIMK.HR dated 26.10.2026)
Contract basis for six months; any extension depends on performance/administrative requirements
Maximum 35 years (as on date of notification)
Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, Kozhikode, Kerala

content_sections.heading: About IIM Kozhikode
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (भारतीय प्रबंध संस्थान कोषिक्कोड़) is a management institute at IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O., Kunnamangalam, Kozhikode, Kerala State, India – PIN 673570 (Tel: 0495 2809160/ 366). The Video Editor will work on Digital Learning: the post-production of course content written by faculty and the delivery of video modules on Digital Learning platforms. The HR Office of IIMK handles this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification and experience (as revised by the corrigendum): "Graduate (full-time) with first class from a reputed university, with 1–4 years of relevant experience in video editing/post-production. Relevant professional/vocational certification or demonstrated proficiency in the audio-video production field is mandatory." Desirable: Experience in eLearning projects, or in editing digital learning/education-sector video content. The notification also says the candidate should be proficient in: Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects and Final Cut Pro. Direct hands-on exposure to at least one such content creation/authoring tool is a must. One or more visual tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, OBS Studio or Adobe Audition. Working knowledge of these is an added advantage. A sound understanding of pacing, structure and clarity requirements specific to educational/instructional video. Working knowledge of colour correction, audio levelling, captioning/subtitling, and export/compression settings for online delivery. In-depth knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Working knowledge of instructional design (desirable). The ability to keep organised and accurate written and electronic records of all relevant production work. A strong command of written and verbal English. Behavioural competencies including teamwork, flexibility, initiative and self-motivation. The maximum age limit is 35 years (as on date of notification). For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification and its corrigendum. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 35,000 - 40,000/-. The selection committee decides the exact amount based on experience and competence. The engagement is purely on contract for six months. Any further extension depends on performance/administrative requirements.

content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Video Editor – Digital Learning Job Description
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the role covers post-production of course content written by faculty, including editing, motion graphics and storyboard development. The aim is to turn raw recordings into polished, learner-ready video modules delivered across Digital Learning platforms. The key responsibilities are: Edit raw faculty recordings into finished, learner-ready video modules, including cuts, pacing, graphics, captions and audio cleanup. Work regularly with faculty, the production team and other stakeholders so that course videos are recorded, edited and ready for delivery across platforms. Develop digital learning materials, including interactive content, animations, illustrations and motion graphics, and support the creation of online simulations and games. Design and create storyboards and post-production media, along with related course elements such as video/audio editing, images and graphics. Handle complete post-production activities, including editing, graphic design, encoding to different online learning platform specifications (e.g., Open edX, Coursera, SWAYAM), tracking/versioning, and sound. Apply Digital Learning's visual and branding standards consistently across all published video content. Coordinate with the Videographer before editing to understand the shoot intent, available takes and continuity notes. Manage version control, review cycles and the incorporation of faculty feedback through to final sign-off. Organise and archive project files, footage and final assets in line with Digital Learning's content management practices. Coordinate with other departments and technical experts, including IT, to resolve technical issues in production and delivery. Analyse requirements and design/modify eLearning modules using authorised tools across Digital Learning platforms. Identify possible improvements and new course development/editing tools to raise production quality.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Kozhikode Video Editor – Digital Learning
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may apply online at https://iimk.ac.in/ by 05.00 pm on 8 November 2026. Candidates who already applied before the corrigendum do not need to apply again. Photograph Certificates CV Signature These must be uploaded in the format set out in the online portal.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for the selection process and interview based on the details they give in their application. Eligible applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be interviewed. Interview time slots will be sent by e-mail. Applicants should visit the IIMK website and check their emails regularly for updates on the interview schedule, if any. The decision of the Director, IIMK on the selection is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Kozhikode Video Editor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) vacancy for the post of Video Editor – Digital Learning.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Video Editor post?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications has been extended to 8 November 2026 (up to 05.00 pm). The original last date was 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIM Kozhikode Video Editor – Digital Learning post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to be a full-time graduate with first class from a reputed university, with 1–4 years of relevant experience in video editing/post-production. They also need a relevant professional/vocational certification or demonstrated proficiency in the audio-video production field.

faq.question: Q4. Did the corrigendum change the experience required?
faq.answer: Yes. The corrigendum dated 26 October 2026 changed the experience range in the original notification from 2–4 years to 1–4 years of relevant experience in video editing/post-production.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the IIM Kozhikode Video Editor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years (as on date of notification).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an IIM Kozhikode Video Editor – Digital Learning?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 35,000 - 40,000/-. The selection committee decides the amount based on experience and competence.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIM Kozhikode Video Editor post?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://iimk.ac.in/ and upload your photograph, certificates, CV and signature in the format set out in the online portal, by 05.00 pm on 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIM Kozhikode Video Editor post?
faq.answer: Eligible applications are screened and candidates are shortlisted based on their application details. Only shortlisted candidates are interviewed, and their time slots are sent by e-mail.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIM Kozhikode Video Editor job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on contract for six months. Any further extension depends on performance/administrative requirements.

faq.answer: No. The corrigendum states that candidates who have already applied for the post need not apply again.
